import arena,subprocess
b=arena.load_board()
while arena.result(b) is None:
    p=subprocess.run(['./think',b.fen(),'5'],text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
    final=[line for line in p.stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith('best ')][-1]
    uci=final.split()[1]
    if uci not in [m.uci() for m in b.legal_moves]:
        print('Invalid proposed move',final,flush=True)
        break
    print(f'{b.fullmove_number}. {b.san(__import__("chess").Move.from_uci(uci))} ({final})',flush=True)
    b=arena._request('move '+uci)
    print('Opponent:',b.move_stack[-1].uci(),flush=True)
print('Final position:')
arena.show(b)
PY
